{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u010/system/state/workspace/programs/task-227168fb.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Locate the rectangular source pattern (non-background, non-zero cells)
    # and the zero-filled destination rectangle.
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda c: sum(row.count(c) for row in grid))
    src_cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != 0]
    dst_cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 0]
    sr0, sr1 = min(r for r, c in src_cells), max(r for r, c in src_cells)
    sc0, sc1 = min(c for r, c in src_cells), max(c for r, c in src_cells)
    dr0, dr1 = min(r for r, c in dst_cells), max(r for r, c in dst_cells)
    dc0, dc1 = min(c for r, c in dst_cells), max(c for r, c in dst_cells)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(dr0, dr1 + 1):
        for c in range(dc0, dc1 + 1):
            sr = sr0 + (r - dr0)
            sc = sc1 - (c - dc0)
            out[r][c] = grid[sr][sc]
    return out
"
